name: Sharetribe
description_en:
Sharetribe is a hosted platform for building two-sided marketplaces, where an operator connects providers and customers. It offers no-code configuration plus a developer platform for custom storefronts, schemas and transaction flows.

The current product separates building/testing from live operation. Marketplace users, listings and transactions run against managed backend infrastructure; access to frontend code or an open-source template does not by itself establish ownership of the hosted backend.
description_zh:
Sharetribe 是构建双边市场的托管平台，由运营方连接供给方和客户，提供无代码配置，并可通过开发平台定制店面、数据及交易流程。

当前产品将构建测试与正式运营分开。用户、刊登及交易使用托管后端；可访问前端代码或开源模板，不等于拥有托管后端。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure providers, listings and customer transactions rather than a single merchant catalogue.
core_features.explanation_zh: 配置供给方、刊登和客户交易，而非单商家目录。

core_features.explanation_en: Model actions, transitions, payment/payout timing and exception paths.
core_features.explanation_zh: 建模动作、状态变化、支付结算时间及例外路径。

core_features.explanation_en: Subscription includes credits; API activity above them is billed separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 订阅包含 credits，超出 API 活动另计。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Model a rental booking and its cancellation
sections.en: A rental marketplace can define request, provider acceptance, payment, completion and cancellation actions. The transaction-engine page describes calendar bookings, availability, operator intervention and refund rules. Draw who may act at each state and when supplier payouts occur, then compare the configured process with the interface. A working listing page is not proof that cancellation restores inventory or refunds correctly. No booking was executed.
sections.zh: 租赁市场可定义申请、供给方接受、付款、完成及取消动作。交易引擎页描述日历预订、可用性、运营者干预及退款规则。应先画清各状态谁可操作、何时向供给方付款，再对照配置和界面。刊登页可用，不证明取消能正确恢复库存或退款。本文未实际预订。

sections.title_en: Use Build for testing and Live for real transactions
sections.title_zh: Build 用于测试，Live 用于真实交易
sections.en: Current pricing lists Build at US$39/month billed monthly and Live at US$199/month billed yearly; the FAQ also gives US$259 for monthly Live. Build uses test users/listings/payments; Live enables real users and money. Both include one million usage credits per month. The 14-day Build trial is an evaluation period, not free ongoing live operation.
sections.zh: 当前定价列 Build 每月 39 美元、逐月付款，Live 年付折算每月 199 美元；FAQ 另列 Live 月付 259 美元。Build 使用测试用户刊登支付，Live 才启用真实用户及资金；两者每月含 100 万 credits。14 天 Build 试用是评估期，不是持续免费正式运营。

sections.title_en: Activity, not just GMV, drives usage charges
sections.title_zh: 使用费由活动驱动，不只看 GMV
sections.en: Credits model the infrastructure cost of API operations; the page illustrates different costs for reads, searches, writes and image uploads. Repeated searches or background synchronization can therefore affect spend without creating a transaction. Optional credit commitments last 12 months and cannot simply be downgraded during the term. Payment processing, map providers, custom development and frontend hosting can add separate costs even though Sharetribe says no platform transaction fee.
sections.zh: Credits 对应 API 操作的基础设施负载，页面用读取、搜索、写入及图片上传说明不同成本。因此反复搜索或后台同步即使不产生交易，也可能增加费用。可选 credits 承诺持续 12 个月，期内不能直接降档。尽管 Sharetribe 不收平台交易费，支付处理、地图、定制开发和前端托管仍可能另计。

sections.title_en: Separate managed backend from custom frontend hosting
sections.title_zh: 区分托管后端与自定义前端托管
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says the standard backend is hosted by Sharetribe. Custom code connects through APIs and must be hosted by the customer. A domain, payment-provider setup and the marketplace business rules remain operator responsibilities. The transaction engine supports tailored processes, but frontend changes and third-party approvals may still require engineering. No unrestricted self-hosting licence for the current full service was verified.
sections.zh: 定价 FAQ 说明标准后端由 Sharetribe 托管，自定义代码通过 API 连接且需客户托管。域名、支付服务商配置及市场业务规则仍由运营方负责。交易引擎支持定制过程，但前端变化和第三方审批仍可能需要工程。本文未核实当前完整服务的无限制自托管许可。

sections.title_en: Choose it for a marketplace, not just an online shop
sections.title_zh: 适合双边市场，而不只是网店
sections.en: Founders coordinating independent providers and customers have a relevant case; a single retailer may not need provider onboarding and payouts. Start with a listing type, transaction diagram, cancellation policy and payment eligibility. Test permission and dispute paths before launch. No live payment, scale benchmark, credit bill, recovery or export-completeness test was conducted.
sections.zh: 协调独立供给方和客户的创始人有相关场景，单一零售商可能无需供给方入驻和分账。可从刊登类型、交易图、取消规则及支付资格开始，正式上线前测试权限和争议路径。本文未测试真实支付、规模、credits 账单、恢复或导出完整性。
